title: Capacity readiness matrix - NA/EU/APAC phased surge plan 2026 Q3
content:
Purpose:
This working sheet defines a phased ‘surge readiness’ and capacity buffer plan for North America, Europe, and APAC across Q2–Q4 2026. It is intentionally conservative on schedule slippage and includes explicit fallback capacity (regional and cross-region) to maintain SLOs during regional traffic spikes and model rollouts.

Executive summary:
- Goal: Ensure 30–40% headroom above projected steady-state inference token throughput at 95th-percentile load for each region while keeping monthly committed spend targets.
- Primary levers: GPU mix (H100/A100/L4), pre-warming pools, autoscale thresholds, cross-region routing policies.
- Recommendation: Staged capacity additions over six release windows (bi-weekly cadence) with an emergency fast-follow window for unanticipated demand.

Assumptions (baseline inputs):
- Business growth projection: +45% total inference QPS by end of Q4 2026; regional split NA:50%, EU:30%, APAC:20%.
- Typical model mix: 60% LLM-chat (H100 preferred for L32+ seq), 30% medium models (A100 80GB), 10% embedding/low-latency (L4).
- Target utilization band: 60–70% average for committed pools; spiky 95th-percentile target ~75–85% but aim to avoid >90%.
- Lead time to provision dedicated H100 capacity: 6–8 weeks. A100: 4–6 weeks. L4 (spot/cheap autoscale): 1–3 weeks.

Capacity matrix (summary table - vGPU-equivalent units):
Columns: Region | Current pool (vGPU-eq) | Projected steady-state (end Q4) | Headroom target (30%) | Planned additions (units) | Primary GPU type
NA      | 1,200                 | 1,800                      | 540                  | +640 (Q2–Q4 phased)  | mix H100 / A100
EU      | 720                   | 1,080                      | 324                  | +360 (Q3 concentrated) | A100 / H100 (A100 first)
APAC    | 420                   | 720                        | 216                  | +300 (frontloaded Q3)  | L4 + burst H100 via region fallback

Notes on units: vGPU-equivalent is a normalized capacity metric (H100=4.5 vGPU-eq, A100=2.8 vGPU-eq, L4=0.45 vGPU-eq) used for planning. Detailed conversion table attached in linked Confluence page.

Phased rollout timeline (high level):
- Window 0 (now -> 2026-03-31): Stabilize current pools, patch kernel, enable prefix cache tuning.
- Window 1 (2026-04-15): NA pre-warm +160 vGPU-eq (A100); enable shorter batch TTL for interactive routes. Owner: Arjun.
- Window 2 (2026-05-01): APAC burst capacity (L4 autoscale) +120 vGPU-eq equivalent; enable cross-region fallback config. Owner: Sofia.
- Window 3 (2026-05-20): EU capacity commit (A100) +180 vGPU-eq; perf smoke tests. Owner: Liam.
- Window 4 (2026-06-10): NA H100 add (priority for long-context models) +200 vGPU-eq; enable quota isolation. Owner: Maya.
- Window 5 (2026-07-01): Buffer refresh / canary revalidation across all regions +240 vGPU-eq. Owner: Zara.
- Fast-follow emergency window: rolling 2-week procurement/spot fallback if 95th-percentile exceeds projections.

Operational playbook snippets:
- Autoscale thresholds: target 65% sustained usage for 5m windows to trigger scale-up; scale-down at <40% sustained for 15m.
- Pre-warm policy: keep 10% of committed pool in pre-warm for fastest cold-start-sensitive routes (chat interactive).
- Cross-region overflow policy: prefer same-continent, then NA<->EU via peering, APAC fallback only for stateless routes. Add explicit cost meter for cross-region egress.

Utilization scenarios (sensitivity):
- Conservative (+25% demand vs baseline): headroom sufficient in NA/EU; APAC breaches buffer by ~45 vGPU-eq -> trigger L4 spot increase + temporary reroute.
- Aggressive (+60% demand): NA may require immediate additional H100 commit; trigger sales/finance approval process (JIRA-INFRA-6598) for accelerated procurement.

Cost and commit guidance (back-of-envelope):
- H100 committed monthly cost per vGPU-eq ~ $9,000; A100 ~ $5,500; L4 effective spot ~ $350.
- Recommended commitment mix to meet budget: NA 60% commit (A100+H100), EU 70% commit (A100-focused), APAC 40% commit + 60% burst (L4/spot).

Risk register (top 5):
1) Procurement delays for H100 -> mitigation: prioritize A100 first, enable model distillation to smaller variants, increase cross-region capacity.
2) Unexpected multi-region spike (concurrent) -> mitigation: global throttles, degrade to short-context model variants, activate SRE incident runbook.
3) Cost overshoot from cross-region egress -> mitigation: strict routing rules and per-route cost limits in Console.
4) Scheduler kernel regressions after kernel update -> mitigation: staged rollout on canary pool, automated perf/latency gates.
5) Vendor cloud quota constraints -> mitigation: early quota requests, parallel requests across providers.

Immediate action items (owners):
- A: Finalize pre-warm policy doc and instrumentation dashboard (owner: Arjun) — target 2026-03-19.
- B: Submit EU/AZ H100 quota requests and procurement LOI (owner: Liam) — target 2026-03-22.
- C: Implement L4 autoscale template with cost caps (owner: Sofia) — target 2026-03-26.
- D: Create canary evaluation set for Q3 rollouts (owner: Maya) — target 2026-03-18.

Open questions / decision points for leadership:
- Approve mixed-commitment strategy (percentages by region) vs. full-quarter committed uplift.
- Maximum acceptable cross-region egress spend threshold for emergency overflow.

Appendix (quick tables) - Detailed per-region vGPU plan by month (abbreviated):
- April 2026: NA +160, EU +0, APAC +120
- May 2026: NA +120, EU +180, APAC +60
- June 2026: NA +200, EU +90, APAC +80
- July 2026: NA +160, EU +90, APAC +40 (buffer refresh)

Notes to reviewers: this is a working planning sheet — numbers are provisional and should be reconciled with Finance model (linked). Please add comments inline in Drive and flag any procurement blockers.

Provenance: pulled baseline utilization numbers from Console route-level export (Feb 2026); growth input from GTM forecast v3 (Feb 2026).

End of document.
